references.text: Baalah is also mentioned in the description of Simeon's inheritance, which was taken from Judah's portion
Baalat-Beer (Rama in the Negev) is a parallel reference to the cities in Simeon's inheritance that originally belonged to Judah
Baalah and Esen (Asem) are mentioned in Simeon's genealogy as cities where they lived
Another city called Baalah (Kiriath-Jearim) is mentioned in the description of Judah's northern border
